text.tspan: Expiry-crossing release remains an owner decision.
No silent resampling or extended eligibility.
Exact mutation recovery observes local acceptance only.
Missing or erased evidence stays unknown. No replay.
Time flows downward. Solid arrows request, dashed arrows reply.
